title: The Olive Tree and the Fig Tree
summary: Across the rocky pastures and olive orchards of ancient Greece, a memorable encounter unfolded. Through unexpected trial and turning point, each character learns that boasting of green leaves invites the heavy snow that snaps proud branches.
full_text: Across the rocky pastures and olive orchards of ancient Greece, a memorable encounter unfolded. An evergreen olive tree mocked a fig tree for shedding her leaves in autumn: "Look at you, bare and naked, while my leaves remain green all year round!".... The surrounding valley lay quiet in the midday heat, yet within the peaceful scene, natural instincts and rival interests were quietly at work. Before long, the initial quiet gave way to a sharp challenge as unexpected circumstances forced both sides to act. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax. Words of sharp wit and warning were spoken before the final consequence struck. Each party sought to press their advantage, weighing spoken words against unspoken motives. When the decisive moment arrived, neither boastful pretense nor hasty excuses could alter the outcome. The outcome revealed the enduring truth of human character. The experience left behind a timeless truth for all who heard the tale, demonstrating that boasting of green leaves invites the heavy snow that snaps proud branches.
moral: Boasting of green leaves invites the heavy snow that snaps proud branches.
